source_issue.title: It's confusing how to change my password as a logged in user

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
The current process for changing a password in Volto is confusing, as it only allows users to reset their password via the `/login` route using the "Forgot your password" link. We aim to improve this by enabling users to change their password directly from their user profile.

## What needs to be done
We propose to add a "Change my password" feature in the user preferences menu, similar to how it's done in Classic Plone. This will involve ensuring proper authentication for the `/change-password` page and possibly improving the UI for the login-help section.

## Helpful background
Discussions have highlighted that in Classic Plone, the password change option is found in the user preferences. There have also been suggestions to address the authentication issues to ensure users cannot access the change-password page without being logged in.

## Good first steps
1. Review the current user preferences layout and propose changes to include a password change option.
2. Ensure that the `/change-password` page requires authentication.
3. Attend the Volto Team meetings to discuss the workflow and gather insights from other contributors.
4. Look into integrating a function to retrieve usernames based on email for the login help feature.
